title: Fisher vectors on frozen DINOv2-small patches — K=32 (comparison arm)
question: Do K=32 Fisher vectors on the same deep patch tokens beat the sealed deep-patch SPM (0.487/0.563/0.590) or the dense ladder?

interpretation_registered_before_running.comparison: candidate 1 already passed the per-MAC gate; this cell is a comparison, not a gate
interpretation_registered_before_running.win: Fisher earns a deployment consequence ONLY if it beats deep-patch SPM at a comparable width
interpretation_registered_before_running.loss: Fisher closes as a measured comparison point; deep-patch SPM stays the deployment arm
interpretation_registered_before_running.note: K=64 dropped (registered): its 49,152-dim solve needs an 18 GiB centred matrix the daily-driver PC cannot serve; K=32 (width 24,576, Gram 4.8 GiB) is the second rung
